scope: Preserve future exact correction preimages before CAS; bind correction prompts to committed Raw when available

storage.full_preimage_and_postimage: Existing content-correction-constraints.jsonl, durable before canonical page replacement
storage.source_identity: Existing page UID or null, page ID, correction ID, canonical UTF-8 SHA-256
storage.source_spans: Uniquely verified pre/post byte ranges and quote hashes; generated or ambiguous source spans held
storage.retractions: Empty new quote hash with no postimage range
storage.review_and_applied_audit: Compact immutable evidence references; no full source duplication
storage.constraint_consumers: Archived full bodies excluded from ordinary replacement-rule projection
storage.legacy_constraint_without_receipt: Append verified full preimage receipt before CAS; preserve the earlier row
storage.already_applied_recovery: Reuse the original verified pre-CAS receipt; never create a postimage-to-postimage source identity

raw_binding.consumer: Existing applied correction audit append path
raw_binding.identity: Preserved host and correction_turn_ref, never prior source_turn_ref
raw_binding.verified_capture: Exact resolver result with committed Raw SHA, receipt SHA and byte ranges
raw_binding.missing_capture: Explicit held reason and empty source_refs; preserved turn identity can be resolved after Save

covered: UTF-8 pre/post reconstruction and exact byte spans
Missing, tampered and malformed source rejection
Receipt persistence failure leaves canonical source unchanged
Legacy constraint upgrade occurs before page CAS
Fresh review and already-applied recovery ordering
Correction prompt uses its own captured Raw, including chunk boundaries
Missing capture retains exact identity without changing an earlier audit

deployed_archive_canary.scope: Synthetic page mutation in temporary root plus read-only existing captured turn; no production page modification

limitations: Historical preimages absent from existing evidence are not reconstructed by inference
Old recovery artifacts lacking durable preimage evidence are held
This does not establish C2 topic extraction, formal retrieval quality or plan-wide acceptance
